ariel: Quick flag from onboarding: ndcg@10 dropped ~2.0% on holdout_longdoc, but mrr@10 slightly up. This followed PR that changed snippet clipping + a small tokenizer tweak.
matt: Can you paste the eval command?
ariel: `./ci/eval_rerank --model nova-ranker --set holdout_curated --metrics ndcg@10,mrr@10 --seed 11`
sophia: I sampled affected queries: a lot from longform docs where trailing context was trimmed. Short queries look fine.
ariel: We rolled snippet_len 256->192 and enabled unicode-joiner normalization in same PR (bad combo).
ci-bot: scheduled ablation: snippet=256/224/192 normalizer=on/off quant=fp16/int8 (run id rb-3790). ETA 18m. :hourglass:
matt: While waiting, can we snapshot candidate churn for top10 on 50 regressed queries? That helps root cause.
sophia: Doing that now. Expect a CSV in 10m.
ci-bot: ablation summary:
``n
snippet=256 normalizer=off quant=fp16 -> ndcg@10 0.4312 mrr@10 0.2189
snippet=192 normalizer=off quant=fp16 -> ndcg@10 0.4256 mrr@10 0.2202
snippet=256 normalizer=on  quant=fp16 -> ndcg@10 0.4289 mrr@10 0.2214
snippet=192 normalizer=on  quant=fp16 -> ndcg@10 0.4199 mrr@10 0.2227
snippet=192 normalizer=on  quant=int8  -> ndcg@10 0.4178 mrr@10 0.2240
```
ariel: Looks like normalizer+shorter snippet worst. int8 nudges ndcg down further.
matt: Plan: try snippet=224 + keep normalizer, run targeted longdoc slice. If still bad, revert the tokenizer joiner change and keep snippet=192.
sophia: Uploaded churn CSV. Most position shifts concentrated in docs with trailing lists and code blocks (we were trimming those).
ariel: I'll open a quick rollback PR for the joiner and add snippet A/B toggle to canary checklist. Blocking canary until longdoc ndcg within tolerance.
ci-bot: hold flag set for nova-ranker (reason: ndcg regression on holdout_longdoc >1%).
